text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 大家好,欢迎收听《Real Easy English》。
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收聽《Real Easy English》。

text: In this podcast,
we have real conversations in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 我们用简单的英语进行真实的对话,帮助大家学习。
zh_hant: 我們用簡單的英語進行真實的對話,幫助大家學習。

text: I'm Georgie.
And I'm Beth.
You can find a video of this podcast and a worksheet
zh: 你可以在我们的网站上找到这期播客的视频和练习表,
zh_hant: 你可以在我們的網站上找到這期播客的影片和練習表,

text: to help you learn on our website,
bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Beth, how are you today?
I'm good, thank you.
I am very busy.
I have a lot of meetings.
How are you?
I'm OK, thank you, Beth, I don't have many meetings today.
zh: 我还好,谢谢你,Beth,我今天没什么会要开。
zh_hant: 我還好,謝謝你,Beth,我今天沒什麼會要開。

text: But today we are talking about meetings,
zh: 不过今天我们要聊的话题就是开会,
zh_hant: 不過今天我們要聊的話題就是開會,

text: in particular work meetings where you talk to colleagues
zh: 特别是工作中的会议,就是你和同事交流、
zh_hant: 特別是工作中的會議,就是你和同事交流、

text: and discuss ideas or make decisions.
zh: 讨论想法或者做决定的那种。
zh_hant: 討論想法或者做決定的那種。

text: That's right.
OK.
Shall we get started?
Yes.
So, Beth, you have a lot of meetings today.
Do you generally have a lot of meetings at work?
zh: 你平时工作中会经常开很多会吗?
zh_hant: 你平時工作中會經常開很多會嗎?

text: It really depends on what I'm working on.
zh: 这真的要看我在做什么项目。
zh_hant: 這真的要看我在做什麼專案。

text: So if I have a project
where I need to meet a lot of people,
then I might have quite a few meetings.
zh: 那我可能会有相当多的会议。
zh_hant: 那我可能會有相當多的會議。

text: And that's why I'm busy now.
zh: 这也是为什么我现在这么忙。
zh_hant: 這也是為什麼我現在這麼忙。

text: But generally,
we have a lot of, a few meetings together
zh: 我们团队会一起开一些会,
zh_hant: 我們團隊會一起開一些會,

text: as a team.
But I don't think we have loads of meetings.
zh: 但我不觉得我们开的会特别多。
zh_hant: 但我不覺得我們開的會特別多。

text: Compared to other jobs, I don't think we have many meetings.
zh: 跟其他工作比起来,我觉得我们开的会不算多。
zh_hant: 跟其他工作比起來,我覺得我們開的會不算多。

text: Most of our work is producing things
zh: 我们大部分的工作是制作内容、
zh_hant: 我們大部分的工作是製作內容、

text: and editing and writing.
But you're right.
When there are lots of big projects
that we need to talk to other people on the project,
zh: 需要跟项目里的其他人沟通时,
zh_hant: 需要跟專案裡的其他人溝通時,

text: we have more meetings.
But yeah, like you, it really depends.
zh: 但没错,跟你一样,这真的要看情况。
zh_hant: 但沒錯,跟你一樣,這真的要看情況。

text: I think when you need to brainstorm .
zh: 我觉得当你需要集思广益的时候。
zh_hant: 我覺得當你需要集思廣益的時候。

text: So, brainstorm is when you have lots of new ideas
zh: 所谓brainstorm,就是当你有很多新想法,
zh_hant: 所謂brainstorm,就是當你有很多新想法,

text: and you need to talk about them together.
I think then meetings are really useful
zh: 我觉得那种时候开会真的很有用,
zh_hant: 我覺得那種時候開會真的很有用,

text: because you hear lots of new ideas,
zh: 因为你能听到很多新的想法,
zh_hant: 因為你能聽到很多新的想法,

text: and when you're in a room with other people,
zh: 当你和其他人在一个房间里,
zh_hant: 當你和其他人在一個房間裡,

text: if, for example, I have an idea and you say, that's good,
zh: 比如说,如果我有个想法,你说这个不错,
zh_hant: 比如說,如果我有個想法,你說這個不錯,

text: and we can also do this and we can all
zh: 我们还可以这样做,大家可以一起
zh_hant: 我們還可以這樣做,大家可以一起

text: work together,
and I think those kind of meetings are really useful.
zh: 我觉得这种会议真的很有用。
zh_hant: 我覺得這種會議真的很有用。

text: Yeah, I think that way
of doing it is also more efficient.
So sometimes it's better to just have one hour,
zh: 所以有时候只花一个小时,
zh_hant: 所以有時候只花一個小時,

text: come up with ideas and decide on the ideas.
zh: 提出想法然后敲定想法会更好。
zh_hant: 提出想法然後敲定想法會更好。

text: Yeah, definitely.
Do you tend to speak up in meetings?
zh: 你在会议上会主动发言吗?
zh_hant: 你在會議上會主動發言嗎?

text: So, that means do you ask questions
and feel confident to speak?
I think,
if the meeting has lots of people,
I find it a bit more stressful to speak up
zh: 我会觉得发言压力更大一些,
zh_hant: 我會覺得發言壓力更大一些,

text: because I get a bit nervous to speak in front of lots of people.
zh: 因为在很多人面前说话我会有点紧张。
zh_hant: 因為在很多人面前說話我會有點緊張。

text: But if it's a meeting with just
our team, for example,
you guys I like and trust.
zh: 你们这些我喜欢又信任的人,
zh_hant: 你們這些我喜歡又信任的人,

text: I don't mind
speaking up that much.
And sometimes we have meetings
zh: 而且有时候我们的会议是
zh_hant: 而且有時候我們的會議是

text: in person .
Sometimes you have meetings on a call.
So a video call.
Do you prefer meeting
in person or having calls?
I think I prefer meetings in person
zh: 我觉得我更喜欢面对面开会,
zh_hant: 我覺得我更喜歡面對面開會,

text: because you can, you can kind of see
the facial expressions and body language more easily,
zh: 看到面部表情和肢体语言,
zh_hant: 看到面部表情和肢體語言,

text: I think.
And it's easier to know
when a person wants to speak,
zh: 一个人什么时候想发言,
zh_hant: 一個人什麼時候想發言,

text: these kinds of things.
Yeah.
No, I agree with what you're saying.
A lot of the meetings
that I have had recently have been with people
in different time zones in different countries.
zh: 不同国家的人一起开的。
zh_hant: 不同國家的人一起開的。

text: So definitely then
a call is better because
it's the, the best way to speak
zh: 这是最方便的沟通方式,
zh_hant: 這是最方便的溝通方式,

text: without having to go to different countries.
But I agree, I think it's nice
to be able to see body language
zh: 能更清楚地看到肢体语言
zh_hant: 能更清楚地看到肢體語言

text: better
in a face-to-face meeting.
But meetings on calls now are so normal
zh: 但现在通话开会已经非常普遍,
zh_hant: 但現在通話開會已經非常普遍,

text: that there's not loads of difference.
zh: 其实差别也没那么大了。
zh_hant: 其實差別也沒那麼大了。

text: It is also really nice
to be able to take calls in your own house.
zh: 就是可以在自己家里接会议电话。
zh_hant: 就是可以在自己家裡接會議電話。

text: So, working from home can be really nice
zh: 所以在家工作其实挺好的,
zh_hant: 所以在家工作其實挺好的,

text: because you can have your snacks and drinks nearby.
zh: 因为你可以在旁边准备零食和饮料。
zh_hant: 因為你可以在旁邊準備零食和飲料。

text: So yeah, they both have their pros and cons.
That's true. OK, let's recap the language we heard during the conversation,
zh: 没错。好了,我们来回顾一下这次对话中学到的表达,
zh_hant: 沒錯。好了,我們來回顧一下這次對話中學到的表達,

text: starting with brainstorm ,
which is when you get together with a group of people
zh: 意思是和一群人聚在一起
zh_hant: 意思是和一群人聚在一起

text: to come up with ideas.
If you speak up in a meeting,
you express your opinion using your voice.
zh: 就是主动开口表达自己的观点。
zh_hant: 就是主動開口表達自己的觀點。

text: In an in-person meeting,
everyone is in the same physical place.
zh: 所有人都在同一个物理空间里。
zh_hant: 所有人都在同一個物理空間裡。

text: We can also call this a face-to-face meeting.
zh: 我们也可以称之为face-to-face meeting(面对面会议)。
zh_hant: 我們也可以稱之為face-to-face meeting(面對面會議)。

text: And we also talked about having a call.
zh: 我们还聊到了having a call(通话)。
zh_hant: 我們還聊到了having a call(通話)。

text: This could be a phone call or a video call.
zh: 这可以是电话,也可以是视频通话。
zh_hant: 這可以是電話,也可以是視訊通話。

text: And we can also describe this as a remote meeting.
zh: 我们也可以把这种叫做remote meeting(远程会议)。
zh_hant: 我們也可以把這種叫做remote meeting(遠端會議)。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是本期《Real Easy English》的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是本期《Real Easy English》的全部內容。

text: Why not test what you've learned using the worksheet
zh: 不妨用我们网站上的练习表
zh_hant: 不妨用我們網站上的練習表

text: on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 检测一下你学到的内容,网站是bbclearningenglish.com。
zh_hant: 檢測一下你學到的內容,網站是bbclearningenglish.com。

text: And we'll be back next week with another conversation
zh: 我们下周会带着另一段
zh_hant: 我們下週會帶著另一段

text: in easy English.
See you then.
Goodbye.
